constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment:
List of errors messages, contains all errors.
Constructs an uninitialized tool

instanceMethods.name: CreateNewText
instanceMethods.comment: Prepares the text value for analysis. It is the main tool for transferring data from flex to bison If characters page is full, allocates a new page.

instanceMethods.name: RecordNewEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Adds the current record to the list.

instanceMethods.name: RecordIdent
instanceMethods.comment: Creates a new record and sets Ident from myResText.

instanceMethods.name: RecordType
instanceMethods.comment: Starts reading of the type (entity).

instanceMethods.name: RecordListStart
instanceMethods.comment: Prepares and saves a record or sub-record.

instanceMethods.name: CreateNewArg
instanceMethods.comment: Prepares new arguments. Type and value already known. If arguments page is full, allocates a new page.

instanceMethods.name: CreateErrorArg
instanceMethods.comment: Prepares error arguments, controls count of error arguments. If bison handles a sequence of error types, creates only one argument and updates text value.

instanceMethods.name: AddNewScope
instanceMethods.comment: Creates a new scope, containing the current record.

instanceMethods.name: FinalOfScope
instanceMethods.comment: Ends the scope.

instanceMethods.name: ClearRecorder
instanceMethods.comment:
Releases memory.
@param theMode 1 - clear pages of records and arguments2 - clear pages of characters3 - clear all data

instanceMethods.name: GetArgDescription
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a value of fields of current argument.

instanceMethods.name: GetFileNbR
instanceMethods.signature: (theNbHead: number, theNbRec: number, theNbPage: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a value of all file counters.

instanceMethods.name: GetRecordDescription
instanceMethods.signature: (theIdent: string, theType: string, theNbArg: number): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a value of fields of current record.

instanceMethods.name: RecordTypeText
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the record type with myResText.

instanceMethods.name: NextRecord
instanceMethods.comment: Skips to next record.

instanceMethods.name: PrintCurrentRecord
instanceMethods.comment: Prints data of current record according to the modeprint.

instanceMethods.name: PrepareNewArg
instanceMethods.comment: Controls the correct argument count for the record. Resets error argyment mode.

instanceMethods.name: FinalOfHead
instanceMethods.comment: Prepares the end of the head section.

instanceMethods.name: SetTypeArg
instanceMethods.comment: Sets type of the current argument.

instanceMethods.name: SetModePrint
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes the print mode 0 - don't print descriptions 1 - print only descriptions of record 2 - print descriptions of records and its arguments.

instanceMethods.name: GetModePrint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns mode print.

instanceMethods.name: GetNbRecord
instanceMethods.comment: Returns number of records.

instanceMethods.name: AddError
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an error message.

instanceMethods.name: ErrorHandle
instanceMethods.comment: Transfers error messages to checker.

instanceMethods.name: GetLastError
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the message of the last error.
